subject: EdgeScale: retro usage makeup, one-time settlement & term amendment
content:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgescale.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops <ops@edgescale.com>, Finance Team <finance@edgescale.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage report question and next steps

Hi Priya,

Thanks for sending the monthly exports. Our ops team dug through the token logs and we see a significant spike in March that we didn't budget for. Can you confirm whether that was billed against our Dedicated pool or if there was an overflow into hosted?

We pulled the spreadsheet (attached) — it lists a ~1.1M token delta that looks like a retroactive charge. Before we send this to finance, can we get a short write-up from Redwood explaining the source and a settlement proposal?

Tom
Head of Platform, EdgeScale

Attachment: EdgeScale_trueup_breakdown_20270514.xlsx

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgescale.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage report question and next steps

Tom — thanks for flagging and for the attachment. We reviewed the token traces and the short version:

- The March spike is due to a misrouted traffic pattern during a transient autoscale test we ran on 2027-03-12 which caused ~1.05M extra generated tokens to run against your Dedicated pool fallback into our hosted fleet for ~2.5 hours.
- By contract, hosted overflow is billable at the standard per-token hosted rate; however, given the volume and the fact this was system behavior from our autoscaler test, we propose a one-time settlement with a partial credit to smooth the impact.

Proposed settlement (summary):
- Gross overage billed: $4,870.00
- One-time remediation credit: $2,000.00 (technical goodwill + partial absorption)
- Net one-time charge: $2,870.00
- Option: If EdgeScale signs the attached 12-month term amendment (adds 25% reserved capacity and a 6-month minimum), we will further credit $1,000 against this net charge and waive any similar single-event overages for scheduled non-production tests during that term (up to two events).

I've attached a proposed SOW amendment that adds the reserved capacity and the terms described. Vivek and Michael are on copy to help with pricing/PO routing. If that all sounds OK, we can issue a corrected invoice and a DocuSign amendment.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_Amendment_ES-9043_v1.1.docx

---
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgescale.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@edgescale.com>, Ops <ops@edgescale.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage report question and next steps

Thanks Priya,

Appreciate the clear breakdown and the credit. A few questions from our finance team:

1) Can Redwood provide a brief note on controls you will put in place so this doesn't reoccur for production traffic?
2) The PO process at EdgeScale needs a formal invoice and the amendment signed before our AP will release the net charge. Can you send the invoice with line items and a DocuSign link for the amendment?
3) If we sign for the additional reserved capacity, how quickly can you provision the 25% bump in Dedicated pool capacity?

Tom

---
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgescale.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage report question and next steps

Tom — happy to jump in. Short answers:

1) Controls: we've updated the autoscale routing rule to prevent non-production test routes from spilling into hosted fallback. We've also added a circuit-breaker that caps routed overflow for any single customer to 200k tokens/hour by default; ops will notify customers when tests exceed that limit. We'll send a short technical note detailing the rule change and the relevant runbook snippets.

2) Invoice & DocuSign: we'll send a corrected invoice showing gross, credit, and net, and include a DocuSign link for the SOW amendment. Priya — I can prepare the invoice once Finance has the signed amendment or a confirmed PO number; if EdgeScale sends a PO now we can attach it and expedite the invoice.

3) Provisioning: if the amendment signs today we can schedule the capacity bump within 72 business hours; typical lead time is 2–3 business days.

Regards,
Michael Grant
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

---
From: Ops <ops@edgescale.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 07:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage report question and next steps

Priya/Michael — ops here. We can provide a PO immediately (see attached) but need the final net invoice number. EdgeScale is ok to sign the amendment as long as the additional 25% capacity is guaranteed by date + SLAs. Also want explicit language for test exemptions so we can coordinate non-prod tests without incurring charges.

Attachment: EdgeScale_PO_78912.pdf

---
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@edgescale.com>, Ops <ops@edgescale.com>, Finance Team <finance@edgescale.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Usage report question and next steps

Tom / EdgeScale team — thanks for the fast turnaround. Next steps:

1) We've accepted the PO as provisional. Michael will finalize the corrected invoice using the numbers below and attach it to DocuSign.

   - Gross overage: $4,870.00
   - Goodwill remediation credit: $2,000.00
   - EdgeScale sign-up term credit (conditional upon execution of SOW amendment): $1,000.00
   - Net charge to invoice: $1,870.00 (assuming amendment signs and PO is applied). If amendment not executed, net would be $2,870.00.

2) SOW amendment: we updated the amendment to include: 25% guaranteed Dedicated capacity increase, a 5-day SLA for capacity provisioning, and explicit language for up to two scheduled non-prod test exemptions during the 12-month term. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/ES-9043-amendment

3) Technical note and circuit-breaker details will be sent by Naomi to explain runbook changes.

4) Michael — please send the invoice (attach to DocuSign) and CC finance@edgescale.com. We'll mark this as settlement and close the ticket once payment is received and amendment is executed.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Manager — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

---
[End of thread]
